business_problem: Target wanted to help shoppers who start with broad, conversational questions and do not know exactly what they want, reducing the need to sift through large search result sets before finding affordable, relevant products and completing a purchase.
solution_summary: Target built a first-party conversational commerce experience inside ChatGPT so shoppers can begin with natural-language requests instead of traditional keyword search. In the Target app in ChatGPT, a guest tags Target and asks for ideas tied to an occasion, recipient, budget, or dietary preference; ChatGPT provides the conversational front end, while Target returns curated product suggestions across its assortment using its own merchandising authority. The experience is tied directly to commerce actions: users can browse recommendations, add favorites to cart, and complete checkout with a Target account. The flow also connects product discovery to fulfillment options, allowing selection of same-day Drive Up, in-store Order Pickup, or shipping. The source does not disclose storage, retrieval, or model-customization details, but it clearly shows an implemented serving-layer integration between OpenAI's conversational AI and Target's shopping and order-fulfillment systems, built through rapid iteration and frequent testing.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational interface where guests ask broad shopping questions and receive curated recommendations.

solution_components.name: Target app in ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Delivers Target's in-chat shopping experience, returning occasion- and budget-aware product suggestions and enabling cart-building actions.

solution_components.name: Target account
solution_components.role: Supports authenticated purchase completion after shoppers choose recommended items.

data_flow: A shopper opens ChatGPT, tags Target, and asks a natural-language shopping question. The Target app in ChatGPT returns curated recommendations from Target's assortment, the user browses and adds favorites to cart, then completes purchase with a Target account and selects fulfillment through same-day Drive Up, in-store Order Pickup, or shipping.
business_outcome: Target made shopping more intuitive by letting guests discover personalized product options conversationally inside ChatGPT and move directly into purchase and fulfillment selection; internally, the team also moved from idea to launch in a matter of weeks.
architecture_clues: The experience runs inside ChatGPT as a conversational shopping surface for Target.
The implementation links recommendation, cart building, checkout, and fulfillment selection in one flow.
Target said the team built and tested new versions multiple times a day because ChatGPT is in constant development.
